About Our Service

Custom Cut Light Strands

We measure your roofline and custom cut every strand for a perfect fit. No extra bulbs or messy cords for a clean professional look.

Premium C9 Commercial LEDs

Our lights are ultra bright, energy efficient, and built to last. They shine brighter and save you money every season.

Free Takedown and Storage

We remove your lights after the holidays and store them for you at no extra cost. Your lights stay organized, safe, and ready for next year.

Heavy Duty Weatherproof Clips

We use high grade clips that withstand wind, snow, and freezing temperatures. They attach securely to shingles and gutters without damage.
